column1: # Viral mock communities: real sequencing reads, known composition.
# One dataset per row. Edit this file, then run `bash run_all.sh`.
# Use `-` for any column that does not apply; never leave a cell empty.
# The first ten columns are the same, in the same order, as
# ../Real_Data/datasets.tsv, because phase 2 IS that pipeline's phase 2.
#   dataset          name; becomes Data/work/mock_<dataset>/ and the run name
#   study            subdirectory under Data/Mock_dataset/
#   accessions       the libraries, one coverage column each
#   read_type        short -> metaspades + `-x sr`; long -> metaflye + `-x map-ont`
#   viral_enriched   yes -> every contig is viral, no geNomad
#   source           always `sra` here: phase 1 leaves reads in the work directory
#   assembly_dir     unused
#   import_from      unused
#   assembler        megahit for the short rows; `-` would derive
#                    metaspades/metaflye from read_type
#   mean_read_length `-` -> phase 2 measures it
#   notes            recorded in the dataset manifest
# Mock-only columns
#   provider         ena (FASTQ off the ENA mirror) | dataverse (INRAE, by DOI)
#   source_id        the study accession or dataset DOI
#   reads_format     fastq | fasta (fasta is converted in phase 1)
#   reference_set    the reference bundle phase 3 labels contigs against
# See README.md for what each dataset is and what it tests.
dataset
dsmz_dsrna
column11: DSMZ/INRAE plant-virus synthetic community, dsRNA protocol (J Virol 2023, 10.1128/jvi.01300-23). 22 libraries over nested sub-communities (12x 5-virus, 6x 10-virus, 3x 20-virus, 1x 60-virus) from one pool of 115 reference molecules in 68 agents, so the coverage columns carry real presence/absence structure and the truth asks for multipartite segments to be co-binned.

column1: dsmz_vana
column11: Same 22 sub-communities and reference set as dsmz_dsrna, VANA protocol (virion-associated nucleic acids) instead of purified dsRNA. VANA sees DNA viruses that dsRNA misses and covers the RNA virome less completely.

column1: phage_mock_illumina
column11: 15-phage mock community, Illumina MiSeq (Microb Genom 2024, 10.1099/mgen.0.001198; ENA PRJEB56639). Genomes 44.5-320 kb, 28-61% GC, copy numbers over four orders of magnitude, and a microdiversity cluster (J1/J2 100% identical, SLUR29/SWAN 87%). All three runs sequence the same community, so the coverage columns are replicates and carry little differential signal.

column1: phage_mock_nanopore
column11: Same community and reference set as phage_mock_illumina, Oxford Nanopore MinION: 4 original runs plus 3 re-basecalled (ONT1/2/3_v2). ERR12141278 is much smaller (116 Mbp) and is kept as a low-depth column. The study's 3 PacBio Sequel runs are not registered - they are CLR and need --pacbio-raw, not the --nano-hq this pipeline uses.
